engineeringSkip.reason: This is a speculative mash-up of nanotechnology, swarm robotics and 3D printing with no real research programme behind it, and its claimed ability to instantly assemble city-scale structures from trillions of nanoscale printers is not credibly grounded in known physics or engineering.

factCheck.reason: It mashes together molecular manufacturing, swarm robotics and 3D printing into a claim of instant city-scale construction that has no coherent engineering basis and ignores fundamental limits on energy, heat and control.
